note: A sphere and a box drawn by one banded-normal GLSL ES 3.00 shader (built-in x3d_ModelViewMatrix, x3d_ProjectionMatrix, x3d_NormalMatrix, x3d_Vertex, x3d_Normal and the fields tint, bands and level as uniforms); the fields change through events.
